notes.title: Heads Will Roll: Reforged - Sins of the Floating City — Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/35094948/7bf0f72feda243af1df42f81d5973459d413e37b.jpg[/img]
[b][h1]The fourth major expansion for Heads Will Roll: Reforged has been released![/h1][/b]
[previewyoutube=I0jVrLytCLA;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3857000/Heads_Will_Roll_Reforged__Sins_of_the_Floating_City/

[h2]What awaits you in the DLC:[/h2]
- No step too far, no measure too desperate:
Become the right hand man of the Venetian Doge and plunge headlong into the maelstrom of European politics to help Venice survive the onslaught of an alliance of its many rivals. Enlist the help of allies and defeat your enemies on the battlefield or, through cunning intrigues and sophisticated machinations, set them against each other in order to reap the fruits of their discord. Deception, betrayal, bribery and political assassinations - achieve your goal by any means available and dare to take the most desperate steps for the sake of the greatness of Venice.

- A descent into darkness:
Enter the service of an influential Italian noble house, surrounded by enviers and grudge-bearers, and take on the role of a bodyguard who will protect its members from the dangers that lurk everywhere and the traps set by their enemies. Descend into darkness as you make your way through the Venice's underworld that will confront you with powerful secret societies, mysticism, blood feuds and the many vices and sins of human nature.

- More than a dozen new characters:
From members of various Italian noble houses and famous condottierros to the emperor of the Holy Roman Empire himself.

- Europe-spanning adventure:
Visit Italy, France, Holy Roman Empire and the Outremer all within one continuous campaign.

- 2 new romantic interests:
Each with their own unique story and character.

[h1]Special Offer.[/h1]
To celebrate the release of the new expansion, all previous DLCs are now 50% off
If you’ve been waiting for the best opportunity to grab the game, now is the time: the base game is 75% off.

notes.title: Console Patch XBOX and PLAYSTATION
notes.content:
Hello friends.

We are excited to announce that a new patch has been released for We. The Revolution on Xbox and PlayStation. 

We've addressed many issues, for a long time garnered thanks to the console players' feedback. 
The patch includes several fixes and adjustments. 

Read the [b]PATCH NOTES[/b]: 

[url=https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/we-the-revolution/9N6GVB6SP7L9]Xbox[/url] - 1.0.0.8 : 
- Fixed Family Bonds, Marriage Counseling, All Debts Are Paid, Friendship, Peace and Love, Good Eating Deserves Good Drinking
- Fixed missing Polish translations.
- Fixed missing Russian translations.
- Fixed change language option not working.
- Fixed intrigue not being resolved and blocking the game progression.
- Fixed missing sprites in some relations with family options.
- Fixed infinite loading screen after changing Xbox user.

- Fixed riots not being possible to be stopped.

Our dearest community!

We’re very proud to share this special event with you - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/klabater]Klabater Publisher Sale[/url].
We offer our entire catalog with exceptional deals for a week starting now, prices even [b]up to 90% off![/b] Many of the games just got their [b]deepest discounts ever[/b], so if you ever wondered whether to purchase any game from our portfolio, but you haven’t yet, now it is the right time!

notes.title: THE AMAZING AMERICAN CIRCUS WITH A NEW RELEASE DATE, BETA TESTS AND TRAILER
notes.content:
Hey guys!

We have already informed you about the upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1433860/The_Amazing_American_Circus/]The Amazing American Circus game[/url]. In Klabater we treat it as an unofficial last part of our history-inspired trilogy which includes We. The Revolution as well. We really hope you guys will find The Amazing American Circus interesting!!! 

We are pleased to announce that The Amazing American Circus will hit PC and consoles on[b] August 12[/b] this year but that we will also like to share the new trailer and to let you know about upcoming beta tests for this game. 

First of all, please check the new trailer introducing the story of the game:

[previewyoutube=Pr4orTHO_as;full][/previewyoutube]

The decision to postpone the premiere to August is due to the commitment to the final quality and enjoyment of the game, and the additional time needed to properly certify the game on all console platforms. But we also want to let you test the game (below!). We are pleased with the quality of the game as it stands and believe that the best we can do in the coming weeks is just to let the gamers who follow the production play it.

[b]BETA TESTS[/b]

Tomorrow ([b]May 7[/b]) Klabater will start the initial beta testing phase of the game. The players who supported the game during the successful Kickstarter campaign will get to play it first. 

Buuut… on [b]May 20[/b], the open beta tests will begin, which will be carried out with the help of the [b]Steam Playtest[/b] mechanics - details will be provided soon (it is worth following the information appearing on the official [url=https://discord.gg/zJxgnMguvY]The Amazing American Circus Discord channel[/url]). Players will be able to test fragments of the first of the four regions available in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31187053/79750b50d7f0fb28538c562ce8ba1fd4f4d84cb5.jpg[/img]

Below is a planned map of the development of Klabater's flagship title for 2021:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31187053/0cbd1131905fd50c83d51dc32c5f73aa5f9363de.jpg[/img] 

The Amazing American Circus is a blend of a Slay the Spire-style card game with Tycoon and simulation mechanics, as well as thoughtful resource management. Manage not only your artists but the entire circus camp. How you expand your circus depends only on you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31187053/26746fa376c648717a2e9a9afb8dba8a7d129e05.png[/img]

What The Amazing American Circus has to offer?:

🎪 Become a legend! Save a run-down circus, gather a troupe of performers, and dare to defy the greatest showman on earth - P.T Barnum himself.
🎪 Recruit and train over 15 different types of circus artists
🎪 Take part in exciting battles on the circus arena using the beautifully illustrated collectible cards
🎪 Upgrade your circus caravan thanks to different types of wagons offering over 100 possible modifications
🎪 Meet both historical and fictional characters deeply embedded in American folklore, such as John D. Rockefeller, Susan B. Anthony, or Nikola Tesla
🎪 Immerse yourself in a story taking place during the turbulent era of the fading Wild West and enter the beautiful and dark world of Native American folklore and the immigrant populace
🎪 Listen to a unique soundtrack inspired by classic circus music and American country & folk

[b]The Amazing American Circus will be released on August 12, 2021[/b]!

[list]
[*] Game’s [url=https://discord.gg/zJxgnMguvY]Discord[/url] channel
[*] [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/AACircusGame]Facebook[/url] profile
[*] [url=https://twitter.com/CircusAmazing]Twitter[/url] profile
[/list]

notes.title: HELIBORNE: ENHANCED EDITION AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

[i]Heliborne[/i] is one of the most successful Klabater's releases. Initially released in 2017, it remains one of the publisher’s flagships. Today we would love to let you know that the game just debuted in its ultimate shape!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/b679693ecfa085b455b2ba8cff0639dc9f29d810.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne[/i], the Ultimate Helicopter Warfare Experience, is now taken to new heights as the game officially becomes [b][i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i][/b]! The game’s definitive edition brings not only tons of improvement and new content but also debuts at a new price (29,99 USD/EUR) for both the game and all DLCs included! 

--> Heliborne: Enhanced Edition [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433530/Heliborne/]Steam Card[/url]
--> WATCH HELIBORNE ENHANCED EDITION[url=https://youtu.be/28X5Dn9Zw-0] TRAILER[/url]

From now on there is only one ‘Enhanced’ edition of the game containing the base game with all the DLCs released until now (over a dozen!) in the price of the regular game! [b]Klabater decided that all the gamers who already paid for the original edition will now receive Enhanced Edition and ALL DLCs for free[/b]!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/67427e0114be9e46650b7dd2044510f40ded0839.jpg[/img]

[i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i] is the next big step for the franchise, meant as a final version of the [i]Heliborne[/i] game dedicated to those who love the game already but also for newcomers. It’s a brand new visual quality mixed with significant gameplay overhaul. The development team is now working on the console edition of Enhanced Edition, and more info will be revealed soon!

With [i]Heliborne: Enhanced Edition[/i], the Ultimate PC Helicopter Warfare Experience is now taken to new heights! 
[list]
[*] New Prototype Machines 
[*] Fully Upgraded Game Engine 
[*] New Day & Night Maps 
[*] Updated in-game Physics 
[*] Empowered Multiplayer Experience 
[*] Refreshed User Interface
[/list]
[b]As we promised to our community, all who have bought the game before will get the free update to Enhanced Edition! This is our way of saying thank you’ to all the community that helped us and supported us for years. So, even if you own the basic version of the game with no DLC installed, you will still get access to both the Enhanced Edition of the game and ALL DLCs released until now! Enjoy![/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33938074/8df5edc6ebc48de7fbfd170c2c503e9d1c54e615.jpg[/img]
[b]WHAT’S IN IT FOR THE PLAYERS?[/b]

With Heliborne: Enhanced Edition players get the basic game and over a dozen of cool DLC at a very, very reasonable price. A summary of a player’s ‘savings’ below:
[list]
[*] The previous Heliborne price was 19,99 USD/EUR, and DLCs were altogether worth   54,85 USD/EUR... So, until now, the whole package cost 75 USD/EUR.
[*] From August 20, the 75 USD/EUR value content will be priced at 29,99 USD/EUR... As simple as that! You get EVERYTHING at once, and [b]you SAVE 60%[/b]! 
[/list]
KLABATER TEAM

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31187053/d2e5182aa2cbf41f2fb4508e923c1053e2c096ff.jpg[/img]

We get a lot of feedback that you guys are constantly interested in new additions to the game. And as always, we're on duty! And this time we have something special for you:) Not just your usual patch, but really cool addition to the game.

We have worked on special [b]"Arena mode"[/b] for [i]We. The Revolution[/i] for some time. Thanks to this mode you will be able to delve into the times of the French Revolution again. We know that many of you enjoy the court cases the most! So, Arena mode will let you play just court cases without involving into family issues and strategical clashes on map of Paris.

You may try to resolve each case in a different way each time - of course you still need to worry about not being lynched or called a traitor. There are 44 cases overall solving which will let you earn points in the world ranking! So, you may compete not only with the game itself but also with other gamers!

Another huge addition is support for the[b] Russian language[/b]! Comrades, your revolution begins today! We heard many of you asked for it and here it is, enjoy!

notes.title: We. The Revolution Update 1.0.1.
notes.content:

[b]Vive la We. The Revolution! The We. The Revolution Update 1.0.1. is already here![/b]

We are back with a batch of improvements for you today. All of the changes are listed below, and the entire Team is continuing their hard work based on your feedback and suggestions. We truly appreciate how vocal and helpful the community around We. The Revolution is, and promise to continue supporting the game as we have been doing so far.

[b]MAJOR CHANGES[/b]
- All cutscenes can now be skipped
- Added background music to all cases at courthouse
- The results of family actions are now displayed when performed for the first time
- Fixed a critical bug which could block the game (at day 16, act 1) after one of the events
- Added Exit Button at the profile selection menu
- Fixed all audio options

[b]MINOR CHANGES[/b]
- Fixed an issue with missing audio in some cutscenes
- Fixed a few minor issues with cutscenes
- Fixed a few bugs with audio in cutscenes
- Added missing crime icons in cases files
- Fixed a few text typos 
- Audio files have been updated
- Fixed links in a few cases files
- Fixed text during prologue
- Fixed text in intrigue introduction
- Fixed a few issues with achievements
- Fixed tooltip after speech summary 
- Changed name “Defectors” to “Refugees”
- Added additional background for battles
- Fixed “Not found” text on map
- Fixed a few minor bugs on map
- Fixed a few issues with fonts
- Fixed a few UI issues
- Fixed an issue with displaying characters in hierarchy menu
- Fixed issue with the size of a dialogue window
- Deleted case description on game’s save in “Continue” menu

If you encounter any issues, wish to chat about We. The Revolution or just poke the Devs, our Official Steam Forum ([url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/736850/discussions]https://steamcommunity.com/app/736850/discussions[/url]) or Discord Server ([url=https://discord.gg/t7fk6BX]https://discord.gg/t7fk6BX[/url]) are always the best place to visit.

Best,

Polyslash and Klabater Team
